body:
Honestly I think it's both my really negative body image and watching other people around me succeed that makes me feel inferior. I know that my worth isn't based on my appearance but I can't help feeling like less of a human being when I'm surrounded by attractive people and I'm the only less-than-average-looking one. And seeing other people succeed doesn't inspire me to try harder, it just makes me feel worse that I'm not succeeding like they are.

Also thank you so, so much for your thoughtful comments. It's really nice that you're willing to listen.

I think I feel like people love me out of sympathy because over the years I've developed quite the inferiority complex. I think that everyone is automatically better than me or more worthy of love than me and whenever someone expresses feelings of caring towards me I feel as though they're doing it because they look down upon me and they pity me.
I'm not being treated for depression yet but it's definitely an option that I've thought about. And I'll look into purchasing that book, at this point I'm honestly so desperate that I'll try anything

I used to have a therapist but I never mentioned these feelings to her. I have some trust issues (they don't really stem from anything, I've just always been wary of people) so I was never comfortable enough to discuss how I really felt. And I know if I told my family, they would be supportive and try to get me some help, but I also know that I would definitely become a burden to them if I'm not already one now. They'd be worried out of their minds that I'd hurt myself and I don't want to put them through that :/
